newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Airlines increases tourist season flights.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Airlines increases tourist season flights.

text.p: Croatian national flag carrier Croatia Airlines said on Friday it would increase international services during the coming tourist season, adding flights from coastal resorts to its main destinations in Europe.
From March 30, Croatia Airlines will fly daily from Zagreb to Paris Charles de Gaulle in a joint venture with Air France, it said.
The airline will add a Sunday flight to the Thursday and Saturday flights between Split and Paris via Zagreb.
In cooperation with Alitalia, Croatia aims to start daily flights Monday to Friday between Zagreb and Milan from May 1.
The airline will also fly to Madrid from Zagreb for the first time on Mondays and Thursdays starting in June.
It will link Split and Frankfurt five times a week except on Friday and Sunday. Fridays will be added to the schedule in April and between June 6 and October 25.
At Easter, Croatia launches weekly Sunday returns between Dubrovnik and Paris. It will fly Dubrovnik-Frankfurt each Friday in May.
From April 23, it plans to fly from Split to Zurich Wednesdays and to Amsterdam and London Heathrow Saturdays.
Starting from May, there will be Split-London Gatwick runs each Thursday, and flights from Zagreb to Pula on the Istrian peninsula and onto Amsterdam Sundays.

The airline rescheduled to Monday and Friday its current twice-weekly hauls from Zagreb to Stockholm and onto Goeteborg, Sweden, as well as Zagreb-Copenhagen to Wednesday and Sunday. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
